summary: Document the owner's explicit preference that agents do not send progress pings, routine questions, or manual-work requests while authorized ICARUS tasks remain. Agents should keep working on non-conflicting scope, coordinate through the shared bus, record external blockers, and reserve owner contact for when the applicable work queue is complete or truly requires owner-only authority.
evidence: Owner explicitly requested no contact until current and future work is complete and said not to ask them to do manual tasks.
